statusMeaning.wired-to-source: All currently linked media exists in durable website source. Review capture date and build separately.
statusMeaning.archived-reference: An explicitly labelled historical source image is preserved; it is not a new/current capture.
statusMeaning.capture-pending: The catalog has not been wired to complete durable capture media.
statusMeaning.missing-linked-media: At least one currently linked media file is absent or invalid.
statusMeaning.file-present: The requested basename exists; this alone does not verify its content or freshness.
statusMeaning.accepted-alias: The reviewed capture is wired under an explicitly accepted alternative filename.
statusMeaning.unavailable: Capture is intentionally blocked; the protection remains in place.
statusMeaning.not-attempted: A dependent screen was not attempted after the protected entry screen blocked capture.
statusMeaning.pending: The requested basename does not exist in durable source.
statusMeaning.build-only: A legacy or uncatalogued asset exists only in generated build output.
